title: selenicereus undatus
intro: Selenicereus undatus, commonly known as the "Queen of the Night" or "Night-Blooming Cereus," is a species of cactus that blooms only at night, producing showy white flowers that are highly fragrant. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Selenicereus undatus include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation.
